title: How do you get to school?

before.predict: Look at the picture. How do the children travel to school?

text.title: Our class travels to school
paragraphs: Last week we asked all 24 students in our class one question: how do you get to school?
Twelve students **walk**. They live near the school, so they only need ten **minutes**. “I **walk** with my sister every morning,” says Malika. “It is good exercise and it is free,” she says.
Six students take the **bus**. The **bus** stops in front of the school. Sardor lives **far** away, so his journey takes thirty **minutes**. He gets up at six o'clock every morning to catch it.

Four students come by **bicycle**. They are fast and they are never late! Two students take the **metro** with their father. “I am never in traffic,” says Jasur, “and my bicycle is red and very fast.”
And our teacher? She drives a small red car. “The traffic is terrible,” she says. “Next year I want a **bicycle** too!” We think that is a very good idea!

tf: There are 24 students in the class.
